title: Incidence of Diabetes by Income Group
what_it_is: Incidence of Diabetes by Income Group

sections.label: Diabetes data by income
sections.summary: Data on diabetes incidence by income level is unavailable, but other countries' studies show lowest-income groups tend to have higher obesity and diabetes prevalence.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Data on diabetes incidence by income level is not available.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, studies in other countries have shown that those in the lowest-income group tend to have higher prevalence of obesity and diabetes.

sections.label: Healthier Choice Symbol products
sections.summary: Through HPB's Healthier Choice Symbol, Singaporeans can find a wide variety of healthier food products suiting different budget needs.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Through HPB's Healthier Choice Symbol, Singaporeans can find a wide variety of healthier food products that suit different budget needs.

sections.label: Healthier Corporate Food Bundle
sections.summary: HPB is collaborating with the Food Bank Singapore to develop a Healthier Corporate Food Bundle including whole grain staples and healthier oils for lower-income households.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As part of our ongoing efforts to reach out to lower-income households, HPB is collaborating with the Food Bank Singapore to develop a Healthier Corporate Food Bundle, which includes whole grain staple products and healthier oils.

sections.label: Steps Challenge and Screen For Life
sections.summary: HPB's National Steps Challenge reached over 500,000 Singaporeans, and Screen For Life subsidies were enhanced from 1 September 2017 with capped payments for eligible groups.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, HPB's National Steps Challenge has reached out to more than 500,000 Singaporeans to encourage them to remain physically active.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Screen For Life subsidies have been enhanced from 1 September 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Eligible Singaporeans will pay no more than $5, CHAS cardholders will only pay $2, while Pioneer Generation cardholders need not pay.
